Status Detail.value: A Power magazine article from October 23, 2025 reports that Google signed a power purchase agreement for the plant. Kiewit Power Constructors leads engineering, procurement and construction. The owner expects a financing decision in the second quarter of 2026 and commercial operation in 2030.
Status Detail.note: The article names the plant, the Mitsubishi turbine, Kiewit and the financing and operating targets. I did not find a report that the financing decision has closed or that construction has started.

units.notes: Status stays pre-construction. I found no report after the October 2025 article that financing closed or construction began. Latest Activity is left alone because the newest report is under a year old.
